Customs

ปล่อยของทันที

A customs procedure allowing the prompt release of goods upon arrival and preliminary assessment, often before the final determination of duties, under authorized programs.

Quick answer: A customs procedure allowing the prompt release of goods upon arrival and preliminary assessment, often before the final determination of duties, under authorized programs.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A customs procedure allowing the prompt release of goods upon arrival and preliminary assessment, often before the final determination of duties, under authorized programs.

Operational example

The shipment qualified for immediate release under the express customs program, minimizing delays at the border.
